description: The pie chart illustrates the "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," displaying a total of 13 distinct categories. There is no separate legend; instead, the category labels and their exact percentages are positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective slices via thin grey lines, rather than being placed inside the segments. The largest slice is NQ (blue) at 31.3%, followed by FEVER (teal) at 16.1%, SNLI (orange) at 15.4%, VITAMINC (cyan) at 13.0%, and MULTINLI (salmon) at 11.3%. The remaining smaller slices include ANLI (dark orange) at 4.6%, FACTCC (green) at 2.6%, ENTFA (yellow) at 1.8%, XSUMHUL (pale blue-grey) at 1.6%, SCITAIL (light green) at 1.2%, MULTIFC (light blue) at 0.5%, PUBHEALTH (pale yellow) at 0.5%, and SCIFACT (a very thin sliver) at 0.1%. None of the slices are visually emphasized, exploded, or offset, and the segments do not appear to be ordered by size in either a clockwise or counter-clockwise direction.
